from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
im = np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B = im[:,:,0],im[:,:,1],im[:,:,2]
red = (R>120)&(R-G>50)&(R-B>50)
yellow = (R>150)&(G>120)&(B<110)&(R-B>60)&(G-B>40)
black = (R<70)&(G<70)&(B<70)
# white/gray metallic: high all, low saturation
mx=np.maximum(np.maximum(R,G),B); mn=np.minimum(np.minimum(R,G),B)
gray=(mx-mn<30)&(mx>90)
H,W=R.shape
for y in range(0,H,4):
    row=''
    for x in range(0,W,2):
        if red[y:y+4,x:x+2].sum()>2: c='R'
        elif yellow[y:y+4,x:x+2].sum()>3: c='Y'
        elif black[y:y+4,x:x+2].sum()>4: c='#'
        elif gray[y:y+4,x:x+2].sum()>4: c='M'
        else: c='.'
        row+=c
    print(row)
